jobs.description:

Job Overview/Duties:

· Officers will conduct regular, scheduled foot patrol of school campus buildings, campus perimeter and parking lot(s) as outlined in job site security procedures, to deter criminal activity and trespassers.

· Officers will assist with general traffic flow/control during school drop off and pick up times.

· Officers will prevent unauthorized access by identifying each campus “visitor” through school staff.

· Officers will maintain ongoing communication with school staff utilizing “walkie talkie”, phone and other communication devices.

· Officers will complete daily activity and incident reports as outlined in their job site security procedures.

· Officers will observe and report any incidents immediately to proper staff

· Officers will utilize good customer service skills, being mindful of ethical and professional boundaries around students at campus.

· Officers will act proactively and identify potential areas of security improvements on campus.

Qualifications for location:

· Must be at least 25 years old

· High school diploma/GED

· Must be able to pass an onsite drug screen and background check.

· Proficient written and oral communication skills.

  • Working mobile Cellular phone with ability to download and utilize Security Application

jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Part Time Visitor Intake in Houston, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Chemical/Petrochemical, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As a Front Desk Security Professional at a chemical/petrochemical location, you will welcome visitors, manage access control and badge processes, monitor entry activity, and provide outstanding customer service. You will help maintain a professional, secure environment through clear communication, attention to detail, and a caring approach. At Allied Universal, you will be part of an agile, reliable, and innovative team that puts people first and acts with integrity.

Position Type: Part Time

 Pay Rate: $14.71 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeSat07:00 AM - 07:00 PMSun07:00 AM - 07:00 PM

What You'll Do

  • Provide professional customer service at the front desk by greeting visitors, responding to inquiries, and directing personnel to appropriate contacts or locations.
  • Monitor access to the chemical and petrochemical location by verifying visitor credentials, issuing visitor passes, and maintaining accurate entry and exit records in accordance with site-specific procedures.
  • Conduct required visitor screening and access-control activities, including communicating site requirements and escalating discrepancies to designated personnel.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following site-specific emergency response procedures.
  • Maintain clear and accurate logs, reports, and communications related to front-desk and security-related activities.

Minimum Requirements

  • At least six months of security-related experience is required.
  • Comfortable using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • A guard card or license is preferred.
  • Access control and badge experience is preferred.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.title: Security Officer (Part Time) - Now Hiring
jobs.description:
Security Officer (Part Time)

Would you like to be part of a team that keeps the cast, crew, celebrity guests and co-workers at The Walt Disney Company safe and secure? Our Security Officers do it all, from working special events like Disney shows to regular perimeter checks of our buildings and offices. If you thrive in an environment where no two days are exactly alike, and where professionalism and precision are valued, apply today to join us!

As a Security Officer, you’d be part of a well-trained, cohesive team that provides 24/7 protection for co-workers and guests at our buildings and at special events. Your mission? To protect Disney property and safeguard our people!

Every day as a Security Officer is different! Depending on your shift, on any given day you might:

  • Greet visitors, check company IDs, and provide temporary IDs at building entrances

  • Evaluate and screen the audience line at live TV shows

  • Be a security presence at movie premiers, live performances, events, or private parties

  • Patrol hallways and building perimeters to spot safety issues or irregularities

  • Fill out the logbook precisely and completely

  • Answer questions asked by visitors and employees in a friendly, professional way

  • Use your know-how and training to diffuse a tense situation

  • Respond to medical or fire incidents, and work directly with local first responders

  • Assist private security details brought by celebrities, sports stars, politicians and visiting dignitaries – even the President has been known to stop by

  • Control messenger flow and package delivery

  • Utilize technology to report and document incidents and manage information flow

  • Perform walk-through evaluation at off-site events

Here’s what you will need to be successful in the job:

  • 1 year of corporate security, law enforcement or military experience

  • Excellent communication skills, including fluent written and spoken English, and strong command of basic English grammar

  • Ability to make quick decisions using your training and common sense

  • The knack for talking to people in a friendly way that gets results

  • A “team” orientation and willingness to collaborate

  • Physical ability to perform all aspects of the job and be outside in all weather; and

  • Flexible workdays/hours (this is a “shift work” role) and ability to work some overtime

It would be a plus if you also have these skills:

  • Valid Security Guard license issued by your state

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite

  • Experience working under pressure

  • Ability to take command and diplomatically control difficult situations

Education is important to us, here is what we are looking for:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required

  • Associate degree or higher preferred

Some of the perks we offer include:

  • Taking part in ongoing learning on subjects such as CPR, Imminent Threat Assessment and First Aid training.

  • Attending a movie screening or television taping, enjoying the full array of benefits offered by The Walt Disney Company including paid time off, 401K participation, a retirement savings plan, discounts on a wide variety of offerings, medical/dental/vision insurance and educational reimbursement-just to name a few!

jobs.title: Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Front Desk
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Front Desk in Houston, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $15.50 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeWed02:00 PM - 06:00 PMThur02:00 PM - 06:00 PMFri02:00 PM - 06:00 PM

How This Role Works

  • Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.
  • Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. It’s all up to you.

This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer service to clients, visitors, and employees by carrying out site-specific security-related procedures and front desk policies at a chemical/petrochemical location.
  • Control access by greeting visitors, verifying credentials, issuing visitor badges, maintaining visitor logs, and directing authorized personnel to appropriate areas.
  • Monitor access points, alarms, cameras, and other security-related systems from the front desk, reporting unusual activity or equipment concerns according to site procedures.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following emergency response procedures and notifying appropriate personnel.
  • Maintain accurate records of visitor activity, deliveries, incidents, and other front desk communications while providing professional support to Allied Universal and site personnel.

Minimum Requirements

  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Access control/badge experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.
